verdict.rationale: Twenty provides native custom dashboards with configurable chart types, filters, aggregation, and grouping over pipeline/activity data, with real-time widgets for pipeline health, team performance, and revenue trends — all built in-app without needing spreadsheet exports (twenty-docs-6, twenty-docs-20, twenty-docs-21, twenty-docs-57, twenty-docs-48). Data export is offered only as an optional side capability, not a requirement for reporting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of dashboard depth and reporting accuracy (only vendor docs cited, and community evidence [twenty-comm-1] notes general 'alpha-version' rough edges without specifically addressing dashboards).
